title: Universal LPC Summary Schema Bootstrap Repair
changes: Reproduced the Windows Build all failure where a current Universal LPC revision marker allowed a legacy generated summary without a top-level counts object to bypass complete repository re-indexing.
Added a lightweight Universal LPC generated-summary validator covering canonical schema, locked commit, strict certification, inventory counts, revision marker, and required generated catalogs.
Changed the Bash build to rebuild the complete Universal LPC repository index whenever its summary is missing, malformed, stale, partial, legacy, or inconsistent with the pinned source.
Added post-index summary certification to both Bash and PowerShell build paths before the combined LPC project foundation runs.
Replaced the combined foundation builder's direct summary counts lookup with explicit schema and inventory validation so future failures produce actionable errors instead of KeyError exceptions.
Updated the authoritative cumulative handoff and apply instructions to Pass 167Z41.

validation.strictFullRepositoryReindex: pending Windows workstation run with mounted Universal LPC source
